blocks.html: Robinsons Malls now offer safe and accessible COVID-19 vaccination sites to the public as part of its support with the LGU’s COVID-19 prevention and vaccination efforts.

More Robinsons Malls branches will open up as vaccination sites as it remains dedicated its commitment to fight the battle against COVID-19. Due to its strategic location in key cities, large and clean spaces, and accessibility, Robinsons Malls has become the preferred sites to launch each city’s vaccination drive.

To date, thousands of frontliners, medical healthworkers, Barangay Health Workers, Barangay Health Emergency Response teams, Barangay Nutrition Scholars, Senior Citizens- and even Tuguegarao City Mayor Jefferson Soriano and Antipolo City Mayor Andeng Ynares- were inoculated in Robinsons Place Tuguegarao and Robinsons Place Antipolo. Vice Mayor Mike Rama as Cebu City vaccine czar, appointed by Mayor Edgardo Labella, together with Councilor David Tumulak attended the initial inoculation activity at Robinsons Galleria Cebu, encouraging more Cebuanos to get vaccinated. Following these vaccination activities will be a four-day vaccination drive in Robinsons Place GenSan benefiting senior citizens in Barangay Bula, General Santos City.

For more updates, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like Robinsons Malls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
